title: Agro-Entrepreneur
description: Rooted in Hadejia's agricultural heartland. You start with high grain reserves and trade potential, but liquid cash is tied up in seasonal harvest cycles.
perks: 15% higher payout on agricultural trading and market jobs.

title: Dutse Civil Servant
description: Based at the State Secretariat in Dutse. Enjoys a respectable social standing and steady routine, though monthly wage growth is modest.
perks: Gains +5 Mutunci automatically every 7 in-game days.

title: Tech & POS Hustler
description: Operating near FUD campus and commercial hubs. Fast-moving, resourceful, and always on the move, but needs to work hard to earn community elder respect.
perks: Energy drains 10% slower while performing urban and tech hustles.

title: Royal & Elite Heritage
description: Descended from historic lineages with deep roots in local affairs. Starts with substantial wealth and maximum social standing, but faces heavy community expectations.
perks: Double Mutunci loss on unethical actions; unlocks exclusive high-society events.
